description: Malformed media is dropped SILENTLY (no wire response exists for datagrams): an impossible instance id (0) and a payload that is not frame-aligned.
preconditions: Session PLAYING; the receiver is in epoch instance 1, generation 1.
Datagrams are untrusted input (TB1/TB2): validation before allocation, bounded consumption (§5.5 of threat-model.md).

steps.note: 5-byte payload: 5 % 8 != 0 — not a whole number of F32LE stereo frames.

assertions: Expected wire behavior: NONE — media has no response channel; both datagrams are dropped and logged locally (§7.5).
No decode, no state change, no concealment counting for malformed media; dedup/loss accounting is unaffected.
Flagged adjacent gap (not vectorized): §7.5 also lists 'reserved flag bits set' as malformed, but §7.1 and the §12 parked row say reserved bits are IGNORED — see media/flags-reserved-ignored.
